Private Styling

60 minutes to turn your personal style into something more intentional, effortless and distinctly you.

In this private 60-minute session, discover the colours that bring out your natural beauty, the silhouettes that flatter your body, and the details that complement your face — from glasses and accessories to hairstyles and patterns. Stop spending on pieces that never quite feel right, and start making choices that truly work for you.

What to Expect
  • Complete body architecture assessment — silhouette balancing, neckline curation, and proportion mapping for your frame.
  • Facial geometry analysis covering eyewear fitting, accessories, hairstyle recommendations, and pattern matching.
  • A wardrobe editing strategy session so you leave knowing exactly what to keep, donate, and shop for next.
Duration: 60 minutes
Location: ASHTA District 8, SCBD, Jakarta
Investment: IDR 3.800.000
